rawContent: For all the young folks ignoring urges to socially isolate because #Coronavirus isn’t that serious (in their mind). How ‘bout the us adults ignore the #ClimateCrisis? If the planet dies, it dies. I’ve worked a very long time to get where I am, I just wanna have fun.  <sarcasm>
